commission_rules_scope_target.name: commission_rules_scope_target
commission_rules_scope_target.value:
("commission_rules"."scope" = 'USER' AND "commission_rules"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "commission_rules"."parking_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("commission_rules"."scope" = 'PARKING' AND "commission_rules"."parking_id" IS NOT NULL AND "commission_rules"."user_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("commission_rules"."scope" IN ('GLOBAL_INDIVIDUAL', 'GLOBAL_BUSINESS') AND "commission_rules"."user_id" IS NULL AND "commission_rules"."parking_id" IS NULL)

leads_contact_present.name: leads_contact_present
leads_contact_present.value: "leads"."phone" is not null or "leads"."email" is not null
